req.title: Reject squadNumber lookup for non-numeric value
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when GET /players/squadNumber/{value} receives a non-integer segment.
triggers: reject squadnumber lookup for non-numeric value

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-037 requires HTTP 422 when GET /players/squadNumber/{value} receives a non-integer path segment. FastAPI enforces path parameter type coercion; a non-integer value causes a 422 Unprocessable Entity before the route handler executes. The violation was test[5] (test_get_by_squad_number_alphanumeric_mixed_returns_422) which had kind=negative but heuristic=EP — EP is only valid for positive tests in this context; the heuristic is corrected to NEG since it exercises a negative equivalence class of invalid (mixed alphanumeric) inputs. All other tests are preserved unchanged.

tests.name: test_get_by_squad_number_valid_integer_returns_200
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
expected: Response body contains squadNumber equal to 10
trace: R-PLAYER-037: valid integer must NOT be rejected; 200 proves the validator accepts integers
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
assert r.status_code == 200
body = r.json()
assert body['squadNumber'] == 10

expected: HTTP status is NOT 422 (negative integer is still an integer; expect 404)
trace: R-PLAYER-037: '-1' is a valid integer (negative boundary); must NOT yield 422 — catches mutations that reject all non-positive values

tests.name: test_get_by_squad_number_empty_segment_returns_404_or_405
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: Send GET /players/squadnumber/ (empty segment, effectively hitting the collection route)
expected: HTTP status is NOT 422 for empty segment (route does not match; expect 404 or 405)
trace: R-PLAYER-037: empty path segment does not match the {squad_number} route at all; distinguishes 422 (type error) from routing errors
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/')
assert r.status_code in (404, 405, 307, 200)
assert r.status_code != 422
